cases.scope_note: Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. All 92 frozen obligations independently read against the complete reference, original 14-file engineering attachment and alignment. Exact original attachment matches first-terminal sealed source; independent isolated Lean compilation and axiom audit passed. AI semantic judgment is distinct from kernel compilation and is not human approval.
复核有限 CW 商的 HEP、锥与悬挂的替代实现、积分扭结和若干不可恢复性见证。尤其检查三胞腔交换子的悬挂 Hurewicz 像，合法证明了两个不同空间的稳定信息相同。无独立错误断言。
逐项复查收敛分母、最佳逼近、误差估计、二次无理量一致型和实际共用 F 的傅里叶矛盾。没有把起点变化或指数的不同量词偷换成统一常数。无独立需处罚的数学断言。
复核全部实高度凸上图、紧次水平取到、共同紧纤维及有限闭投影交。分离证明含纯水平分离的情形，可比较双方允许无穷值的竞争者。实际投影反例也支持最外闭化必要性。没有独立未证断言。
复查有限群商、任意群的层化与相对下降、基底变换及两个反例的真范围。非零截面确由非局部常值函数的取负构造，单点无法检测。局部满射反映、仅非空不反映均有见证。
复查零伪距核和对所有严格递增取样的稀疏块下界，确认有限与无穷上极限都受控制。可达参数构造实际满足单调整数、端点和取极限顺序。无独立数学错误或虚报范围。
原非幂等族、模4可行障碍、Gram 高一位范数和两域特例耦合均检查。不可行、有限假解、严格包含和两点轨道的额外断言逐一可实现。Cayley 矩阵在两域全部精度有单位分母，附带可靠性完整。
逐项核对完成与实际层、对角带权除法、扭结分类和分裂见证。按指数分层得到 E 的显式形式幂级数模型，逐 r 扭结公式正确。额外断言完整，无与数学正向贡献重复的罚项。
复核三元阈值、全部固定集合及任意乘积边缘。额外奇循环计数和三点阈值见证有效，有限支撑置换的 Fin 商也有依据。无独立错误断言。
全文认可六段实际论证，末行建议针对字面方向，并保留该行正确的非必要性。常值塔的两个说明与 lim¹ 障碍可验证，未推断原答缺交一般非交换存在性或有效矩阵反例。
逐项复核该审阅保留的正文、两条可独立闭合的证明，以及仿射类型错误的影响。以单方程和方向平移作合法核查，附加的分类逆向、非冗余等问题均有实际依据。未误拒原主证。
审查固定目标的恒等反例、普通指数输入错置、CGHaus 的独立修复与三色之外的实际超滤开覆盖边界。准确保留全目标紧生成判据与连续复合。遗漏映射空间 U 小性只是未交该核查，无虚假大小断言或核心放行。
核查两个实际局部化模型、任意点集实际闭点约化、S2 比较依赖及 Pic 的合法同伦不变转移。所给度零层化加半局部泛点单射可施于同伦不变预层的核余核，修复完整。无虚假结论、失效范围外传播或错引扩展。

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Complete audit of the scoped node-domain refinement: distinguishes the valid canonical construction and extensional theorem from the overbroad operational relation. The alternate four-point one-node/self-loop counterexample preserves all original network conditions and keeps both refined endpoints reachable. Repair restricts full edge equalities to retained endpoint pairs, correctly avoiding an overstrong global choice projection after pruning.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Correctly identifies the unconditional all-reachable-path Lip certificate requirement as a genuine loss of the original evaluable-path scope. Both inclusions and same-path joint quantifiers remain valid under that stronger premise. The alternative four-point pseudometric network rules out all certificates on an unsampled reachable path and proves the scope difference; proposed conditional certificates are sufficient. Native event54 supports the original-module and two supplementary declaration checks.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Correctly accepts the exact node-domain refinement construction and extensional theorem. Checks full partition, exact local restrictions, all retained full edge domains, entries, reachability pruning and the actual construction-to-relation bridge. The explicit five-point self-loop example correctly distinguishes enlarged terminal domains after pruning from required unused retained edges. Extra full operator equality and depth conclusions follow the supplied actual path projection.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Correct concise aligned audit of the two specified inclusions. It gives the evaluable-path witness, the actual local bound, exact guarantee-domain threshold, actual path-chain/proxy bridge and shared-path joint argument; the wrapper conditions and stronger-scope boundary are retained. It does not separately reproduce the hLq function type, the common target domain or the residual formula; these are not credited as separately explained. The concrete local-to-global derivations and cited actual declarations are sufficient for this scoped audit, without requiring exhaustive reference reproduction. Native event54 supports43-module compilation and the three stated axiom checks.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Complete original final read: LCH01.lean, Main.lean, build configuration, all eight structured alignment explanations and21 mapped declarations. All eight original mathematical obligations, representations and extended-value boundaries are valid. Independent isolated original-source compilation and declaration audit passed. Native event76 confirms the separate lake build,21-claim axiom report and leanchecker replay claims; earlier native settings failure is not confused with the later success.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Read the complete original inline final, all four Lean modules and all20 alignment entries. The precise matrix orientation, actual intermediate domains, arbitrary finite positive chain lengths, zero-step boundary and quantified path criteria all match the selected source obligations. Original sources independently compile and their mapped declarations pass the allowed-axiom audit; no source correction or inherited model judgment.

Core and ancillary assertions in this complete original final were reviewed separately from completion counts and compilation. Read the complete original final: Main plus Bounds/Chains/Channels, all40 mapping entries, build configuration and every completion claim. All40 original targets and necessary bridges are complete. The Fin3/Unit all-infinite discrete gauge is a valid alternative nonattainment example. Independent original-source compilation and axiom audit passed; native events175/195/225/243 separately confirm build, replay,97 mapped/147 module-constant checks and frozen-source hashes. ZIP mathematical files equal the delivered inline and sealed source. No candidate scripts executed and no source repairs.
